source_header: theorem modelPoint_boolean (N : ℕ) (i : Fin (N + 1)) : eval (modelPoint N) (booleanConstraint i) = 0

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.modelPoint_coarse
informal_statement: For N>=24 the explicit rational model satisfies the coarse generators.
source_header: theorem modelPoint_coarse (N : ℕ) (hN : 24 ≤ N) (i : Fin (N + 1)) : eval (modelPoint N) (coarseConstraint i) = 0

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.modelPoint_bertrandPolynomial
informal_statement: For N>=24 the model zeros the actual interval polynomial under its explicit interval hypotheses.
source_header: theorem modelPoint_bertrandPolynomial (N : ℕ) (hN : 24 ≤ N) (m : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hmN : 2 * m ≤ N) : eval (modelPoint N) (bertrandPolynomial N m) = 0

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.modelPoint_bertrandFamily
informal_statement: For N>=24 the model zeros every actual coarse/Bertrand generator.
source_header: theorem modelPoint_bertrandFamily (N : ℕ) (hN : 24 ≤ N) (j : BertrandFamilyIndex N) : eval (modelPoint N) (bertrandFamily N j) = 0

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.modelPoint_g_zero
informal_statement: For N>=24 the model zeros the original ordered g.
source_header: theorem modelPoint_g_zero (N : ℕ) (hN : 24 ≤ N) : eval (modelPoint N) (g N ℚ) = 0

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.modelPoint_differs_from_primePoint
informal_statement: For N>=24 the explicit rational model differs from the prime point.
source_header: theorem modelPoint_differs_from_primePoint (N : ℕ) (hN : 24 ≤ N) : modelPoint N ≠ primePoint N ℚ

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.bertrandFamily_common_zero
informal_statement: For N>=24 an actual rational Boolean/coarse/Bertrand/g common zero is supplied.
source_header: theorem bertrandFamily_common_zero (N : ℕ) (hN : 24 ≤ N) : (∀ j, eval (modelPoint N) (bertrandFamily N j) = 0) ∧ (∀ i, eval (modelPoint N) (booleanConstraint i) = 0) ∧ eval (modelPoint N) (g N ℚ) = 0

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.bertrandFamily_has_second_boolean_solution
informal_statement: For N>=24 both prime and distinct model points satisfy the family without g.
source_header: theorem bertrandFamily_has_second_boolean_solution (N : ℕ) (hN : 24 ≤ N) : (∀ j, eval (primePoint N ℚ) (bertrandFamily N j) = 0) ∧ (∀ i, eval (primePoint N ℚ) (booleanConstraint i) = 0) ∧ (∀ j, eval (modelPoint N) (bertrandFamily N j) = 0) ∧ (∀ i, eval (modelPoint N) (booleanConstraint i) = 0) ∧ modelPoint N ≠ primePoint N ℚ

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.bertrandFamily_no_certificate
informal_statement: For N>=24 this exact coarse/Bertrand family has no supplied certificate identity.

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.CoprimeDivisor.nearFullPrimeSelection_iff_omitted_card_le_one
informal_statement: Near-full prime selection means at most one prime coordinate differs from one.
source_header: theorem nearFullPrimeSelection_iff_omitted_card_le_one {N : ℕ} (x : Fin (N + 1) → ℚ) : NearFullPrimeSelection N x ↔ (omittedPrimes N x).card ≤ 1

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.CoprimeDivisor.pairDivisors_prime_pair
informal_statement: The coprime-prime pair divisor set consists of those two primes.
source_header: theorem pairDivisors_prime_pair (N : ℕ) (p q : Fin (N + 1)) (hp : Nat.Prime p.val) (hq : Nat.Prime q.val) : pairDivisors N p.val q.val = {p, q}

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.CoprimeDivisor.family_implies_ordered_prime_pair_selected
informal_statement: The coprime family forces at least one coordinate of each ordered distinct prime pair to be one.
source_header: theorem family_implies_ordered_prime_pair_selected {N : ℕ} (x : Fin (N + 1) → ℚ) (hF : ∀ m, eval x (family N m) = 0) (p q : Fin (N + 1)) (hp : Nat.Prime p.val) (hq : Nat.Prime q.val) (hpq : p.val < q.val) : x p = 1 ∨ x q = 1

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.CoprimeDivisor.family_implies_nearFullPrimeSelection
informal_statement: The coprime-divisor family implies near-full prime selection.
source_header: theorem family_implies_nearFullPrimeSelection {N : ℕ} (x : Fin (N + 1) → ℚ) (hF : ∀ m, eval x (family N m) = 0) : NearFullPrimeSelection N x

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.CoprimeDivisor.nearFullPrimeSelection_implies_family
informal_statement: Near-full prime selection implies all coprime-divisor equations.
source_header: theorem nearFullPrimeSelection_implies_family {N : ℕ} (x : Fin (N + 1) → ℚ) (hx : NearFullPrimeSelection N x) (m : Index N) : eval x (family N m) = 0

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.CoprimeDivisor.family_iff_nearFullPrimeSelection
informal_statement: The rational coprime-divisor equations are exactly near-full prime selection.
source_header: theorem family_iff_nearFullPrimeSelection {N : ℕ} (x : Fin (N + 1) → ℚ) : (∀ m, eval x (family N m) = 0) ↔ NearFullPrimeSelection N x

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.CoprimeDivisor.family_iff_at_most_one_omitted_prime
informal_statement: The rational coprime-divisor equations hold iff at most one prime coordinate differs from one.
source_header: theorem family_iff_at_most_one_omitted_prime {N : ℕ} (x : Fin (N + 1) → ℚ) : (∀ m, eval x (family N m) = 0) ↔ (omittedPrimes N x).card ≤ 1

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.CoprimeDivisor.primePoint_family
informal_statement: The prime point satisfies this module's actual family under its declared index hypotheses.
source_header: theorem primePoint_family (N : ℕ) (m : Index N) : eval (primePoint N ℚ) (family N m) = 0

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.CoprimeDivisor.onePoint_family
informal_statement: The all-one point satisfies this module's family.
source_header: theorem onePoint_family (N : ℕ) (m : Index N) : eval (ProperBertrand.onePoint N) (family N m) = 0

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.CoprimeDivisor.exceptPoint_family
informal_statement: The one-coordinate-flip point satisfies this module's family.
source_header: theorem exceptPoint_family (N : ℕ) (target : Fin (N + 1)) (m : Index N) : eval (ProperBertrand.exceptPoint N target) (family N m) = 0

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.CoprimeDivisor.family_does_not_pin_any_coordinate
informal_statement: For every coordinate the family has a Boolean model taking each of zero and one there.
source_header: theorem family_does_not_pin_any_coordinate (N : ℕ) (target : Fin (N + 1)) : (∀ m, eval (ProperBertrand.exceptPoint N target) (family N m) = 0) ∧ (∀ i, eval (ProperBertrand.exceptPoint N target) (booleanConstraint i) = 0) ∧ ProperBertrand.exceptPoint N target target = 0 ∧ (∀ m, eval (ProperBertrand.onePoint N) (family N m) = 0) ∧ (∀ i, eval (ProperBertrand.onePoint N) (booleanConstraint i) = 0) ∧ ProperBertrand.onePoint N target = 1

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.CoprimeDivisor.family_has_second_boolean_solution
informal_statement: A Boolean family model distinct from the prime point is supplied under the exact source hypotheses.
source_header: theorem family_has_second_boolean_solution (N : ℕ) : (∀ m, eval (primePoint N ℚ) (family N m) = 0) ∧ (∀ i, eval (primePoint N ℚ) (booleanConstraint i) = 0) ∧ (∀ m, eval (ProperBertrand.onePoint N) (family N m) = 0) ∧ (∀ i, eval (ProperBertrand.onePoint N) (booleanConstraint i) = 0) ∧ ProperBertrand.onePoint N ≠ primePoint N ℚ

informal_statement: The bounded least-factor coordinate has the expected natural value.
source_header: theorem leastFactor_val {N : ℕ} (u : Fin (N + 1)) (hu : 2 ≤ u.val) : (leastFactor u).val = Nat.minFac u.val

source_header: theorem leastFactor_dvd {N : ℕ} (u : Fin (N + 1)) (hu : 2 ≤ u.val) : (leastFactor u).val ∣ u.val

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.CoprimeKaryIdeal.leastFactor_injective_on
informal_statement: Least-factor selection is injective on the declared pairwise-coprime arithmetic index.
source_header: theorem leastFactor_injective_on {N k : ℕ} (S : Finset (Fin (N + 1))) (hS : ArithmeticAllowed k S) : Set.InjOn (leastFactor (N := N)) (S : Set (Fin (N + 1)))

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.CoprimeKaryIdeal.leastFactor_image_primeAllowed
informal_statement: The least-factor image is an allowed prime k-subset.
source_header: theorem leastFactor_image_primeAllowed {N k : ℕ} (S : Finset (Fin (N + 1))) (hS : ArithmeticAllowed k S) : PrimeAllowed k (S.image leastFactor)

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.CoprimeKaryIdeal.leastFactor_image_subset_divisors
informal_statement: The least-factor image lies in the arithmetic divisor set.
source_header: theorem leastFactor_image_subset_divisors {N k : ℕ} (S : Finset (Fin (N + 1))) (hS : ArithmeticAllowed k S) : S.image leastFactor ⊆ divisors N S

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.CoprimeKaryIdeal.primeAllowed_arithmeticAllowed
informal_statement: An allowed prime k-subset is an allowed arithmetic index.
source_header: theorem primeAllowed_arithmeticAllowed {N k : ℕ} (T : Finset (Fin (N + 1))) (hT : PrimeAllowed k T) : ArithmeticAllowed k T

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.CoprimeKaryIdeal.prime_divisors_eq
informal_statement: The divisor set of an allowed prime subset is that subset.
source_header: theorem prime_divisors_eq {N k : ℕ} (T : Finset (Fin (N + 1))) (hT : PrimeAllowed k T) : divisors N T = T

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.CoprimeKaryIdeal.arithmetic_factorization
informal_statement: The actual arithmetic product factors through its selected least-prime-factor product.
source_header: theorem arithmetic_factorization {N k : ℕ} (S : Finset (Fin (N + 1))) (hS : ArithmeticAllowed k S) : product N (divisors N S) = product N (S.image leastFactor) * product N (divisors N S \ S.image leastFactor)

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.CoprimeKaryIdeal.arithmeticIdeal_eq_primeIdeal
informal_statement: The actual rational arithmetic k-ary ideal equals the prime k-subset ideal.
source_header: theorem arithmeticIdeal_eq_primeIdeal (N k : ℕ) : arithmeticIdeal N k = primeIdeal N k

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.CoprimeKaryModels.family_iff_omitted_card_lt
informal_statement: For arbitrary rational points, the k-ary family holds iff fewer than k prime coordinates differ from one.
source_header: theorem family_iff_omitted_card_lt (N k : ℕ) (x : Fin (N + 1) → ℚ) : (∀ S : ArithmeticIndex N k, eval x (arithmeticFamily N k S) = 0) ↔ (CoprimeDivisor.omittedPrimes N x).card < k

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.FactorCoverage.primePoint_factorPolynomial

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.FactorCoverage.primePoint_coverage

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.FactorCoverage.properDivisors_prime_square
informal_statement: The proper-divisor set of a prime square consists of its prime root.
source_header: theorem properDivisors_prime_square (N p : ℕ) (hp : Nat.Prime p) (hpN : p ≤ N) : properDivisors N (p ^ 2) = {⟨p, by omega⟩}

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.FactorCoverage.coverage_implies_primePins
informal_statement: Coverage forces the declared small-prime coordinate pins.
source_header: theorem coverage_implies_primePins (N M : ℕ) (x : Fin (N + 1) → ℚ) (hcov : Coverage N M x) : PrimePins N M x

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.FactorCoverage.primePins_implies_coverage
informal_statement: Under M<=N^2 the small-prime pins imply coverage.
source_header: theorem primePins_implies_coverage (N M : ℕ) (hMN : M ≤ N ^ 2) (x : Fin (N + 1) → ℚ) (hpins : PrimePins N M x) : Coverage N M x

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.FactorCoverage.coverage_iff_primePins
informal_statement: Under M<=N^2 coverage is equivalent to prime pins for p^2<=M.
source_header: theorem coverage_iff_primePins (N M : ℕ) (hMN : M ≤ N ^ 2) (x : Fin (N + 1) → ℚ) : Coverage N M x ↔ PrimePins N M x

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.FactorCoverage.square_horizon_pins_prime_coordinates
informal_statement: Coverage through N^2 pins every prime coordinate to one.
source_header: theorem square_horizon_pins_prime_coordinates (N : ℕ) (x : Fin (N + 1) → ℚ) (hcov : Coverage N (N ^ 2) x) (i : Fin (N + 1)) (hi : Nat.Prime i.val) : x i = 1

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.FactorCoverage.square_horizon_and_sieve_pin_vector

source_header: theorem square_horizon_and_sieve_pin_vector (N : ℕ) (x : Fin (N + 1) → ℚ) (hcov : Coverage N (N ^ 2) x) (hsieve : ∀ i, ¬ Nat.Prime i.val → x i = 0) : x = primePoint N ℚ

source_header: theorem modelPoint_small_prime (N p : ℕ) (hp : Nat.Prime p) (hpN : p ≤ N) (hpH : p ≤ N / 2 - 3) : modelPoint N ⟨p, by omega⟩ = 1

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.FactorCoverage.modelPoint_horizonFamily

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.FactorCoverage.horizonFamily_common_zero

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.FactorCoverage.horizonFamily_no_certificate

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.FactorCoverage.horizonFamily_has_second_boolean_solution
informal_statement: Under the explicit horizon hypotheses a distinct second Boolean family point exists.
source_header: theorem horizonFamily_has_second_boolean_solution (N M : ℕ) (hN : 24 ≤ N) (hM : M ≤ (N / 2 - 3) ^ 2) : (∀ j, eval (primePoint N ℚ) (horizonFamily N M j) = 0) ∧ (∀ i, eval (primePoint N ℚ) (booleanConstraint i) = 0) ∧ (∀ j, eval (modelPoint N) (horizonFamily N M j) = 0) ∧ (∀ i, eval (modelPoint N) (booleanConstraint i) = 0) ∧ modelPoint N ≠ primePoint N ℚ

source_header: theorem cubePoint_coarse_zero (N : ℕ) (heven : Even N) (hN : 6 ≤ N) (b : CubeVar N → Bool) (i : Fin (N + 1)) (hi : coarseAllowed i) : cubePoint N b i = 0

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.LiteralCube.cubePoint_coarse
informal_statement: For even N>=6 every cube point satisfies the actual coarse equations.

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.LiteralCube.cubePoint_complement_product
informal_statement: For even N>=6 each cube complementary-coordinate product is zero.
source_header: theorem cubePoint_complement_product (N : ℕ) (heven : Even N) (hN : 6 ≤ N) (b : CubeVar N → Bool) (i : Fin (N + 1)) : cubePoint N b i * cubePoint N b (complement N i) = 0

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.LiteralCube.cubePoint_g_zero

source_header: theorem cubePoint_g_zero (N : ℕ) (heven : Even N) (hN : 6 ≤ N) (b : CubeVar N → Bool) : eval (cubePoint N b) (g N ℚ) = 0

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.LiteralCube.literal_eval
informal_statement: An ordinary literal evaluates to its effective cube factor.
source_header: theorem literal_eval {N : ℕ} (b : CubeVar N → Bool) (l : Literal N) : eval (cubePoint N b) l.polynomial = (effectiveLiteral l).value b

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.LiteralCube.clause_eval
informal_statement: An actual clause evaluates to its coefficient times its effective factors.
source_header: theorem clause_eval {N : ℕ} (b : CubeVar N → Bool) (C : Clause N) : eval (cubePoint N b) C.polynomial = C.coefficient * ((effectiveFactors C).map (Factor.value b)).prod

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.LiteralCube.automatic_eval_zero
informal_statement: An automatic clause is zero everywhere on the cube.
source_header: theorem automatic_eval_zero {N : ℕ} (C : Clause N) (ha : automatic C) (b : CubeVar N → Bool) : eval (cubePoint N b) C.polynomial = 0

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.LiteralCube.clause_nonzero_iff
informal_statement: A nonautomatic clause is nonzero exactly on its declared Boolean-coordinate requirements.
source_header: theorem clause_nonzero_iff {N : ℕ} (C : Clause N) (ha : ¬ automatic C) (b : CubeVar N → Bool) : eval (cubePoint N b) C.polynomial ≠ 0 ↔ ∀ v : CubeVar N, (Factor.bit v ∈ effectiveFactors C → b v = true) ∧ (Factor.negBit v ∈ effectiveFactors C → b v = false)

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.LiteralCube.choices_mem_iff
informal_statement: The clause's allowed Boolean coordinate values have the stated literal characterization.
source_header: theorem choices_mem_iff {N : ℕ} (C : Clause N) (ha : ¬ automatic C) (v : CubeVar N) (q : Bool) : q ∈ choices C v ↔ (Factor.bit v ∈ effectiveFactors C → q = true) ∧ (Factor.negBit v ∈ effectiveFactors C → q = false)

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.LiteralCube.badSet_eq_piFinset
informal_statement: A nonautomatic clause's bad set is the product of its coordinate choices.
source_header: theorem badSet_eq_piFinset {N : ℕ} (C : Clause N) (ha : ¬ automatic C) : badSet C = Fintype.piFinset (choices C)

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.LiteralCube.choices_card
informal_statement: Each coordinate has one allowed choice on effective support and two off it.
source_header: theorem choices_card {N : ℕ} (C : Clause N) (v : CubeVar N) : (choices C v).card = if v ∈ effectiveSupport C then 1 else 2

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.LiteralCube.badSet_card
informal_statement: The exact clause bad-set size equals its declared weight.
source_header: theorem badSet_card {N : ℕ} (C : Clause N) : (badSet C).card = weight C

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.LiteralCube.cube_card
informal_statement: The actual Boolean cube has cardinality two to its declared finite dimension.
source_header: theorem cube_card (N : ℕ) : Fintype.card (CubeVar N → Bool) = 2 ^ dimension N

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.LiteralCube.weighted_common_zero
informal_statement: For even N>=6 strict total clause weight below cube size leaves a full family/Boolean/coarse/g common zero.
source_header: theorem weighted_common_zero (N : ℕ) (heven : Even N) (hN : 6 ≤ N) {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (C : ι → Clause N) (hcover : (∑ j : ι, weight (C j)) < 2 ^ dimension N) : ∃ b : CubeVar N → Bool, (∀ j : ι, eval (cubePoint N b) (family C j) = 0) ∧ (∀ i : Fin (N + 1), eval (cubePoint N b) (booleanConstraint i) = 0) ∧ (∀ i : Fin (N + 1), eval (cubePoint N b) (coarseConstraint i) = 0) ∧ eval (cubePoint N b) (g N ℚ) = 0

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.BooleanCoefficients.coefficients_boolean_mul
informal_statement: An ordinary Boolean-generator multiple has zero support-coefficient image, including infinite variable types.
source_header: theorem coefficients_boolean_mul {σ : Type*} [DecidableEq σ] (i : σ) (p : MvPolynomial σ ℚ) : coefficients (((MvPolynomial.X i : MvPolynomial σ ℚ) ^ 2 - MvPolynomial.X i) * p) = 0

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.BooleanCoefficients.support_card_le_exponent_sum
informal_statement: Finite exponent-support cardinality is at most the total exponent sum.
source_header: theorem support_card_le_exponent_sum {σ : Type*} [DecidableEq σ] (e : σ →₀ ℕ) : e.support.card ≤ e.sum (fun _ exponent => exponent)

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.BooleanCoefficients.coefficients_eq_zero_of_totalDegree_lt_card
informal_statement: Aggregated coefficients vanish when support size exceeds ordinary polynomial degree.
source_header: theorem coefficients_eq_zero_of_totalDegree_lt_card {σ : Type*} [DecidableEq σ] (p : MvPolynomial σ ℚ) (s : Finset σ) (h : p.totalDegree < s.card) : coefficients p s = 0

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.BooleanCoefficients.coefficientAtom
informal_statement: The finite-support atom associated to an ordinary exponent vector.
source_header: def coefficientAtom (e : σ →₀ ℕ) (s : Finset σ) : ℚ

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.BooleanCoefficients.coefficients
informal_statement: Linear aggregation of genuine ordinary exponent coefficients by their finite supports.
source_header: noncomputable def coefficients : MvPolynomial σ ℚ →ₗ[ℚ] (Finset σ → ℚ)

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.BooleanCoefficients.bitMul
informal_statement: The actual finite-support action representing genuine variable multiplication.
source_header: def bitMul (i : σ) (f : Finset σ → ℚ) (s : Finset σ) : ℚ

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.BooleanCoefficients.support_single_one_add
informal_statement: Adding a positive single-coordinate exponent inserts that coordinate into the exponent support.
source_header: theorem support_single_one_add (i : σ) (e : σ →₀ ℕ) : (Finsupp.single i 1 + e).support = insert i e.support

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.BooleanCoefficients.coefficientAtom_single_one_add
informal_statement: The actual support atom obeys the variable-action identity.
source_header: theorem coefficientAtom_single_one_add (i : σ) (e : σ →₀ ℕ) : coefficientAtom (Finsupp.single i 1 + e) = bitMul i (coefficientAtom e)

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.BooleanCoefficients.coefficients_monomial
informal_statement: Ordinary monomial coefficients map to the corresponding scaled support atom.
source_header: theorem coefficients_monomial (e : σ →₀ ℕ) (c : ℚ) : coefficients (MvPolynomial.monomial e c) = c • coefficientAtom e

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.BooleanCoefficients.coefficients_X_mul
informal_statement: Genuine ordinary variable multiplication maps to the actual finite-support bit action.
source_header: theorem coefficients_X_mul {σ : Type*} [DecidableEq σ] (i : σ) (p : MvPolynomial σ ℚ) : coefficients (MvPolynomial.X i * p) = bitMul i (coefficients p)

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.BooleanCoefficients.coefficients_count_mul
informal_statement: The genuine ordinary count-polynomial multiple maps to the actual count multiplier.
source_header: theorem coefficients_count_mul {σ : Type*} [Fintype σ] [DecidableEq σ] (m : ℚ) (p : MvPolynomial σ ℚ) : coefficients (((∑ i : σ, (MvPolynomial.X i : MvPolynomial σ ℚ)) - MvPolynomial.C m) * p) = countMul m (coefficients p)

informal_statement: Actual Boolean-lattice raising action on signed rational support functions.
source_header: def up (f : Finset σ → ℚ) (s : Finset σ) : ℚ

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.BooleanLattice.down
informal_statement: Actual Boolean-lattice lowering action on signed rational support functions.
source_header: def down (f : Finset σ → ℚ) (s : Finset σ) : ℚ

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.BooleanLattice.raiseAt
informal_statement: Defines raise At in the declared module context; exact source is authoritative.
source_header: def raiseAt (i : σ) (f : Finset σ → ℚ) (s : Finset σ) : ℚ

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.BooleanLattice.lowerAt
informal_statement: Defines lower At in the declared module context; exact source is authoritative.
source_header: def lowerAt (i : σ) (f : Finset σ → ℚ) (s : Finset σ) : ℚ

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.BooleanLattice.toggle
informal_statement: Defines toggle in the declared module context; exact source is authoritative.
source_header: def toggle (i : σ) (s : Finset σ) : Finset σ

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.BooleanLattice.toggle_involutive
informal_statement: Toggling one support coordinate twice is the identity.
source_header: theorem toggle_involutive (i : σ) : Function.Involutive (toggle i)

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.BooleanLattice.up_eq_sum
informal_statement: The actual raising operator is the sum of coordinate raising actions.
source_header: theorem up_eq_sum (f : Finset σ → ℚ) (s : Finset σ) : up f s = ∑ i : σ, raiseAt i f s

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.BooleanLattice.down_eq_sum
informal_statement: The actual lowering operator is the sum of coordinate lowering actions.
source_header: theorem down_eq_sum (f : Finset σ → ℚ) (s : Finset σ) : down f s = ∑ i : σ, lowerAt i f s

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.BooleanLattice.raiseAt_sum
informal_statement: Coordinate raising commutes with finite rational function sums.
source_header: theorem raiseAt_sum (i : σ) (F : σ → Finset σ → ℚ) (s : Finset σ) : raiseAt i (fun t => ∑ j : σ, F j t) s = ∑ j : σ, raiseAt i (F j) s

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.BooleanLattice.lowerAt_sum
informal_statement: Coordinate lowering commutes with finite rational function sums.
source_header: theorem lowerAt_sum (i : σ) (F : σ → Finset σ → ℚ) (s : Finset σ) : lowerAt i (fun t => ∑ j : σ, F j t) s = ∑ j : σ, lowerAt i (F j) s

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.BooleanLattice.coordinate_adjoint
informal_statement: Coordinate raising and lowering are adjoint for the declared finite rational pairing.
source_header: theorem coordinate_adjoint (i : σ) (f h : Finset σ → ℚ) : (∑ s : Finset σ, raiseAt i f s * h s) = ∑ s : Finset σ, f s * lowerAt i h s

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.BooleanLattice.coordinate_commute
informal_statement: Distinct-coordinate lowering and raising commute.
source_header: theorem coordinate_commute (i j : σ) (hij : i ≠ j) (f : Finset σ → ℚ) (s : Finset σ) : lowerAt i (raiseAt j f) s = raiseAt j (lowerAt i f) s

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.BooleanLattice.coordinate_diagonal
informal_statement: The same-coordinate commutator is the declared signed diagonal action.
source_header: theorem coordinate_diagonal (i : σ) (f : Finset σ → ℚ) (s : Finset σ) : lowerAt i (raiseAt i f) s - raiseAt i (lowerAt i f) s = (if i ∈ s then (-1 : ℚ) else 1) * f s

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.BooleanLattice.adjoint
informal_statement: The actual total raising and lowering actions are adjoint.
source_header: theorem adjoint (f h : Finset σ → ℚ) : (∑ s : Finset σ, up f s * h s) = ∑ s : Finset σ, f s * down h s

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.BooleanLattice.commutator
informal_statement: The actual commutator acts by variable count minus twice support size.
source_header: theorem commutator (f : Finset σ → ℚ) (s : Finset σ) : down (up f) s - up (down f) s = ((Fintype.card σ : ℚ) - 2 * (s.card : ℚ)) * f s

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.BooleanLattice.up_injective_below_middle
informal_statement: On a pure k layer with strict 2k<card sigma, a zero raising image forces the signed function to vanish.
source_header: theorem up_injective_below_middle (k : ℕ) (hk : 2 * k < Fintype.card σ) (f : Finset σ → ℚ) (hlayer : ∀ s : Finset σ, s.card ≠ k → f s = 0) (hup : ∀ s : Finset σ, up f s = 0) : f = 0

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.BooleanCoefficients.countMul
informal_statement: The actual signed count action, with rational subtraction outside the finite sum.
source_header: noncomputable def countMul {σ : Type*} [Fintype σ] [DecidableEq σ] (m : ℚ) (f : Finset σ → ℚ) (s : Finset σ) : ℚ

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.BooleanCoefficients.countMul_eq_diagonal_add_up
informal_statement: The actual count multiplier equals its signed diagonal action plus raising.
source_header: theorem countMul_eq_diagonal_add_up {σ : Type*} [Fintype σ] [DecidableEq σ] (m : ℚ) (f : Finset σ → ℚ) (s : Finset σ) : countMul m f s = ((s.card : ℚ) - m) * f s + BooleanLattice.up f s

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.BooleanCoefficients.top_layer_vanishes_of_countMul_degree_le
informal_statement: With strict 2k<card sigma, function and count image zero above k force the function zero at and above k.
source_header: theorem top_layer_vanishes_of_countMul_degree_le {σ : Type*} [Fintype σ] [DecidableEq σ] (m : ℚ) (k : ℕ) (hk : 2 * k < Fintype.card σ) (f : Finset σ → ℚ) (habove : ∀ s : Finset σ, k < s.card → f s = 0) (himage : ∀ s : Finset σ, k < s.card → countMul m f s = 0) : ∀ s : Finset σ, k ≤ s.card → f s = 0

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.BooleanCoefficients.bitMul_countMul
informal_statement: On finite types the actual bit and count actions commute for arbitrary rational parameter and signed functions.
source_header: theorem bitMul_countMul {σ : Type*} [Fintype σ] [DecidableEq σ] (i : σ) (m : ℚ) (f : Finset σ → ℚ) : bitMul i (countMul m f) = countMul m (bitMul i f)

source_header: def pinnedFamily (N : ℕ) (i : Fin (N + 1)) : R N ℚ

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.pinnedMultiplier
informal_statement: Defines pinned Multiplier in the declared module context; exact source is authoritative.
source_header: def pinnedMultiplier (N : ℕ) (i : Fin (N + 1)) : R N ℚ

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.complement_involutive
informal_statement: The bounded complementary-coordinate map is an involution.
source_header: theorem complement_involutive (N : ℕ) : Function.Involutive (complement N)

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.pinned_cross_sum
informal_statement: The complementary-coordinate cross sum can be reindexed.
source_header: theorem pinned_cross_sum (N : ℕ) : (∑ i : Fin (N + 1), C (primePoint N ℚ (complement N i)) * X i) = (∑ i : Fin (N + 1), C (primePoint N ℚ i) * X (complement N i))

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.pinned_telescoping
informal_statement: The pinned generators telescope to g minus the prime-point count.
source_header: theorem pinned_telescoping (N : ℕ) : (∑ i : Fin (N + 1), (X (complement N i) + C (primePoint N ℚ (complement N i))) * pinnedFamily N i) = g N ℚ - C (goldbachCount N : ℚ)

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.pinned_control_certificate
informal_statement: A nonzero prime-count premise yields the explicit circular pinned-control certificate.
source_header: theorem pinned_control_certificate (N : ℕ) (hG : (goldbachCount N : ℚ) ≠ 0) : Certificate (pinnedFamily N) (pinnedMultiplier N) (fun _ => 0) (C ((goldbachCount N : ℚ)⁻¹))

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.pinned_family_pins
informal_statement: The pinned family has exactly the prime-indicator common zero.
source_header: theorem pinned_family_pins (N : ℕ) (x : Fin (N + 1) → ℚ) (hF : ∀ i, eval x (pinnedFamily N i) = 0) : x = primePoint N ℚ

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.pinned_certificate_iff_goldbach
informal_statement: Existence of a pinned-control certificate is equivalent to positive ordered count.
source_header: theorem pinned_certificate_iff_goldbach (N : ℕ) : (∃ A U B, Certificate (pinnedFamily N) A U B) ↔ 0 < goldbachCount N

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.pinned_multiplier_degree_le_one
informal_statement: The explicit pinned multipliers have ordinary degree at most one.
source_header: theorem pinned_multiplier_degree_le_one (N : ℕ) (i : Fin (N + 1)) : (pinnedMultiplier N i).totalDegree ≤ 1

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.pinned_B_degree_zero
informal_statement: The explicit coefficient multiplying g is constant.
source_header: theorem pinned_B_degree_zero (N : ℕ) : (C ((goldbachCount N : ℚ)⁻¹) : R N ℚ).totalDegree = 0

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.pinned_summand_degree_le_two
informal_statement: Each explicit pinned multiplier-generator summand has degree at most two.
source_header: theorem pinned_summand_degree_le_two (N : ℕ) (i : Fin (N + 1)) : (pinnedMultiplier N i * pinnedFamily N i).totalDegree ≤ 2

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.g_degree_le_two
informal_statement: The original ordered g has ordinary degree at most two.
source_header: theorem g_degree_le_two (N : ℕ) : (g N ℚ).totalDegree ≤ 2

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.pinned_g_summand_degree_le_two
informal_statement: The explicit constant multiple of g has degree at most two.
source_header: theorem pinned_g_summand_degree_le_two (N : ℕ) : (C ((goldbachCount N : ℚ)⁻¹) * g N ℚ).totalDegree ≤ 2

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.ProperBertrand.exceptPoint_boolean
informal_statement: The one-coordinate-flip point satisfies Booleanity.
source_header: theorem exceptPoint_boolean (N : ℕ) (target i : Fin (N + 1)) : eval (exceptPoint N target) (booleanConstraint i) = 0

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.ProperBertrand.onePoint_family
informal_statement: The all-one point satisfies this module's family.
source_header: theorem onePoint_family (N : ℕ) (m : Index N) : eval (onePoint N) (family N m) = 0

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.ProperBertrand.exceptPoint_family
informal_statement: The one-coordinate-flip point satisfies this module's family.
source_header: theorem exceptPoint_family (N : ℕ) (target : Fin (N + 1)) (m : Index N) : eval (exceptPoint N target) (family N m) = 0

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.ProperBertrand.onePoint_differs_from_primePoint
informal_statement: The all-one point differs from the prime indicator.
source_header: theorem onePoint_differs_from_primePoint (N : ℕ) : onePoint N ≠ primePoint N ℚ

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.ProperBertrand.family_has_second_boolean_solution
informal_statement: A Boolean family model distinct from the prime point is supplied under the exact source hypotheses.
source_header: theorem family_has_second_boolean_solution (N : ℕ) : (∀ m, eval (primePoint N ℚ) (family N m) = 0) ∧ (∀ i, eval (primePoint N ℚ) (booleanConstraint i) = 0) ∧ (∀ m, eval (onePoint N) (family N m) = 0) ∧ (∀ i, eval (onePoint N) (booleanConstraint i) = 0) ∧ onePoint N ≠ primePoint N ℚ

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.ProperBertrand.family_does_not_pin_any_coordinate
informal_statement: For every coordinate the family has a Boolean model taking each of zero and one there.
source_header: theorem family_does_not_pin_any_coordinate (N : ℕ) (target : Fin (N + 1)) : (∀ m, eval (exceptPoint N target) (family N m) = 0) ∧ (∀ i, eval (exceptPoint N target) (booleanConstraint i) = 0) ∧ exceptPoint N target target = 0 ∧ (∀ m, eval (onePoint N) (family N m) = 0) ∧ (∀ i, eval (onePoint N) (booleanConstraint i) = 0) ∧ onePoint N target = 1

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.ProperBertrand.modelPoint_family
informal_statement: For N>=24 the explicit model satisfies the proper interval-only family.
source_header: theorem modelPoint_family (N : ℕ) (hN : 24 ≤ N) (m : Index N) : eval (modelPoint N) (family N m) = 0

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.ProperBertrand.family_common_zero
informal_statement: For N>=24 the proper interval-only family has an actual Boolean/g common zero.
source_header: theorem family_common_zero (N : ℕ) (hN : 24 ≤ N) : (∀ m, eval (modelPoint N) (family N m) = 0) ∧ (∀ i, eval (modelPoint N) (booleanConstraint i) = 0) ∧ eval (modelPoint N) (g N ℚ) = 0

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.ProperBertrand.family_no_certificate
informal_statement: For N>=24 the proper interval-only family has no certificate identity.
source_header: theorem family_no_certificate (N : ℕ) (hN : 24 ≤ N) (A : Index N → R N ℚ) (U : Fin (N + 1) → R N ℚ) (B : R N ℚ) : ¬ Certificate (family N) A U B

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.SignDefinite.coefficient_on_primes_eq_zero
informal_statement: Nonnegative canonical coefficients and prime truth force each prime-supported monomial coefficient to vanish.
source_header: theorem coefficient_on_primes_eq_zero {N : ℕ} (P : R N ℚ) (hcoeff : NonnegativeCoefficients P) (htruth : eval (primePoint N ℚ) P = 0) (d : Fin (N + 1) →₀ ℕ) (hprime : ∀ i ∈ d.support, Nat.Prime i.val) : coeff d P = 0

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.SignDefinite.nonnegative_equation_vanishes_on_sievePoint
informal_statement: A nonnegative-coefficient prime-true equation vanishes on every prime-supported rational point.
source_header: theorem nonnegative_equation_vanishes_on_sievePoint {N : ℕ} (P : R N ℚ) (hcoeff : NonnegativeCoefficients P) (htruth : eval (primePoint N ℚ) P = 0) (x : Fin (N + 1) → ℚ) (hx : SievePoint N x) : eval x P = 0

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.SignDefinite.sign_definite_equation_vanishes_on_sievePoint
informal_statement: A canonical same-sign prime-true equation vanishes on every prime-supported rational point.
source_header: theorem sign_definite_equation_vanishes_on_sievePoint {N : ℕ} (P : R N ℚ) (hcoeff : SignDefiniteCoefficients P) (htruth : eval (primePoint N ℚ) P = 0) (x : Fin (N + 1) → ℚ) (hx : SievePoint N x) : eval x P = 0

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.SignDefinite.sign_definite_family_preserves_sieve_common_zero
informal_statement: A same-sign prime-true strengthening preserves a supplied prime-supported family common zero.
source_header: theorem sign_definite_family_preserves_sieve_common_zero {N : ℕ} {ι κ : Type*} (F : ι → R N ℚ) (P : κ → R N ℚ) (hcoeff : ∀ j, SignDefiniteCoefficients (P j)) (htruth : ∀ j, eval (primePoint N ℚ) (P j) = 0) (x : Fin (N + 1) → ℚ) (hx : SievePoint N x) (hF : ∀ j, eval x (F j) = 0) : ∀ j : ι ⊕ κ, eval x (Sum.elim F P j) = 0

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.SignDefinite.sign_definite_strengthening_has_no_certificate
informal_statement: A supplied prime-supported Boolean/g common zero survives the same-sign strengthening and excludes its certificate.
source_header: theorem sign_definite_strengthening_has_no_certificate {N : ℕ} {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ] (F : ι → R N ℚ) (P : κ → R N ℚ) (hcoeff : ∀ j, SignDefiniteCoefficients (P j)) (htruth : ∀ j, eval (primePoint N ℚ) (P j) = 0) (x : Fin (N + 1) → ℚ) (hx : SievePoint N x) (hF : ∀ j, eval x (F j) = 0) (hBool : ∀ i, eval x (booleanConstraint i) = 0) (hg : eval x (g N ℚ) = 0) (A : ι ⊕ κ → R N ℚ) (U : Fin (N + 1) → R N ℚ) (B : R N ℚ) : ¬ Certificate (Sum.elim F P) A U B

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.booleanConstraint_eval
informal_statement: Evaluating a Boolean generator gives x_i^2-x_i.
source_header: theorem booleanConstraint_eval {N : ℕ} {K : Type*} [CommRing K] (x : Fin (N + 1) → K) (i : Fin (N + 1)) : eval x (booleanConstraint i) = x i ^ 2 - x i

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.booleanConstraint_zero_iff
informal_statement: Over a domain, a zero Boolean generator means x_i is zero or one.
source_header: theorem booleanConstraint_zero_iff {N : ℕ} {K : Type*} [CommRing K] [IsDomain K] (x : Fin (N + 1) → K) (i : Fin (N + 1)) : eval x (booleanConstraint i) = 0 ↔ x i = 0 ∨ x i = 1

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.primePoint_boolean
informal_statement: The prime indicator satisfies every Boolean generator.
source_header: theorem primePoint_boolean {N : ℕ} {K : Type*} [CommRing K] (i : Fin (N + 1)) : eval (primePoint N K) (booleanConstraint i) = 0

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.primePoint_zero
informal_statement: The prime indicator is zero at coordinate zero.
source_header: theorem primePoint_zero {N : ℕ} {K : Type*} [CommSemiring K] (i : Fin (N + 1)) (h : i.val = 0) : primePoint N K i = 0

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.primePoint_one
informal_statement: The prime indicator is zero at coordinate one.
source_header: theorem primePoint_one {N : ℕ} {K : Type*} [CommSemiring K] (i : Fin (N + 1)) (h : i.val = 1) : primePoint N K i = 0

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.primePoint_even_gt_two
informal_statement: Even coordinates greater than two vanish at the prime indicator.
source_header: theorem primePoint_even_gt_two {N : ℕ} {K : Type*} [CommSemiring K] (i : Fin (N + 1)) (he : Even i.val) (ht : 2 < i.val) : primePoint N K i = 0

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.primePoint_coarse
informal_statement: The prime indicator satisfies the declared coarse constraints.
source_header: theorem primePoint_coarse {N : ℕ} {K : Type*} [CommRing K] (i : Fin (N + 1)) : eval (primePoint N K) (coarseConstraint i) = 0

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.certificate_excludes_common_zero
informal_statement: A supplied identity excludes a supplied common zero of all its generators.
source_header: theorem certificate_excludes_common_zero {N : ℕ} {K : Type*} [CommRing K] [Nontrivial K] {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (F A : ι → R N K) (U : Fin (N + 1) → R N K) (B : R N K) (cert : Certificate F A U B) (x : Fin (N + 1) → K) (hF : ∀ j, eval x (F j) = 0) (hBool : ∀ i, eval x (booleanConstraint i) = 0) (hg : eval x (g N K) = 0) : False

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.certificate_nonzero_at_primePoint
informal_statement: A supplied certificate and genuine constraint truth force g to be nonzero at the prime point.
source_header: theorem certificate_nonzero_at_primePoint {N : ℕ} {K : Type*} [CommRing K] [Nontrivial K] {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (F A : ι → R N K) (U : Fin (N + 1) → R N K) (B : R N K) (cert : Certificate F A U B) (hF : ∀ j, eval (primePoint N K) (F j) = 0) : eval (primePoint N K) (g N K) ≠ 0

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.eval_g_primePoint
informal_statement: Prime-point evaluation is the original ordered Goldbach count, including the midpoint loop.
source_header: theorem eval_g_primePoint {N : ℕ} {K : Type*} [CommSemiring K] : eval (primePoint N K) (g N K) = (goldbachCount N : K)

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.goldbachCount_positive_iff
informal_statement: Positive ordered count is equivalent to existence of a prime pair summing to N.
source_header: theorem goldbachCount_positive_iff (N : ℕ) : 0 < goldbachCount N ↔ ∃ p q : ℕ, p.Prime ∧ q.Prime ∧ p + q = N

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.goldbachCount_le
informal_statement: The ordered count is at most N+1.
source_header: theorem goldbachCount_le (N : ℕ) : goldbachCount N ≤ N + 1

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.certificate_goldbachCount_positive
informal_statement: A supplied certificate and prime-truth premises imply positive ordered count.
source_header: theorem certificate_goldbachCount_positive {N : ℕ} {K : Type*} [CommRing K] [Nontrivial K] {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (F A : ι → R N K) (U : Fin (N + 1) → R N K) (B : R N K) (cert : Certificate F A U B) (hF : ∀ j, eval (primePoint N K) (F j) = 0) : 0 < goldbachCount N

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.certificate_implies_goldbach
informal_statement: A supplied certificate and prime-truth premises imply existence of the corresponding prime pair.
source_header: theorem certificate_implies_goldbach {N : ℕ} {K : Type*} [CommRing K] [Nontrivial K] {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (F A : ι → R N K) (U : Fin (N + 1) → R N K) (B : R N K) (cert : Certificate F A U B) (hF : ∀ j, eval (primePoint N K) (F j) = 0) : ∃ p q : ℕ, p.Prime ∧ q.Prime ∧ p + q = N

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.eval_g_rat_nonzero_iff
informal_statement: Rational prime-point g is nonzero exactly when the ordered count is positive.
source_header: theorem eval_g_rat_nonzero_iff (N : ℕ) : eval (primePoint N ℚ) (g N ℚ) ≠ 0 ↔ 0 < goldbachCount N

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.certificate_g_rat_positive
informal_statement: The supplied rational certificate and prime-truth premises give positive prime-point g.
source_header: theorem certificate_g_rat_positive {N : ℕ} {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (F A : ι → R N ℚ) (U : Fin (N + 1) → R N ℚ) (B : R N ℚ) (cert : Certificate F A U B) (hF : ∀ j, eval (primePoint N ℚ) (F j) = 0) : 0 < eval (primePoint N ℚ) (g N ℚ)

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.FiniteFieldPolicy
informal_statement: Defines Finite Field Policy in the declared module context; exact source is authoritative.
source_header: def FiniteFieldPolicy (N k p : ℕ) : Prop

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.bounded_zmod_cast_injective
informal_statement: Reduction is injective on the explicitly bounded nonnegative integer interval.
source_header: theorem bounded_zmod_cast_injective {p bound : ℕ} (hb : bound < p) {a b : ℕ} (ha : a ≤ bound) (hbb : b ≤ bound) : (a : ZMod p) = (b : ZMod p) ↔ a = b

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.bounded_zmod_cast_zero_iff
informal_statement: Within the stated strict field bound, reduction preserves zero.
source_header: theorem bounded_zmod_cast_zero_iff {p bound m : ℕ} (hb : bound < p) (hm : m ≤ bound) : (m : ZMod p) = 0 ↔ m = 0

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.goldbachCount_le_momentBound
informal_statement: The ordered count obeys the declared integer moment bound.
source_header: theorem goldbachCount_le_momentBound (N k : ℕ) : goldbachCount N ≤ momentBound N k

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.bounded_sum_le_momentBound
informal_statement: A bounded nonnegative finite sum obeys the declared moment bound.
source_header: theorem bounded_sum_le_momentBound {N k : ℕ} (f : Fin (N + 1) → ℕ) (hf : ∀ i, f i ≤ (N + 1) ^ k) : (∑ i, f i) ≤ momentBound N k

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.finiteFieldPolicy_g_nonzero_iff
informal_statement: The explicit field policy makes prime-point nonzero equivalent to positive integer count.
source_header: theorem finiteFieldPolicy_g_nonzero_iff {N k p : ℕ} (policy : FiniteFieldPolicy N k p) : eval (primePoint N (ZMod p)) (g N (ZMod p)) ≠ 0 ↔ 0 < goldbachCount N

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.finiteFieldPolicy_g_zero_iff
informal_statement: The explicit field policy makes prime-point zero equivalent to zero integer count.
source_header: theorem finiteFieldPolicy_g_zero_iff {N k p : ℕ} (policy : FiniteFieldPolicy N k p) : eval (primePoint N (ZMod p)) (g N (ZMod p)) = 0 ↔ goldbachCount N = 0

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.high_bounds
informal_statement: The selected upper endpoint lies between floor(N/2)+1 and floor(N/2)+2.
source_header: theorem high_bounds (N : ℕ) : N / 2 + 1 ≤ high N ∧ high N ≤ N / 2 + 2

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.high_odd
informal_statement: The selected upper endpoint is odd.
source_header: theorem high_odd (N : ℕ) : high N % 2 = 1

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.bit_boolean
informal_statement: The model's integer bit is idempotent.
source_header: theorem bit_boolean (N n : ℕ) : bit N n * bit N n = bit N n

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.selected_coarse
informal_statement: For N>=24 the selected support satisfies the coarse exclusions.
source_header: theorem selected_coarse (N : ℕ) (hN : 24 ≤ N) : ¬ selected N 0 ∧ ¬ selected N 1 ∧ ∀ n, 2 < n → n % 2 = 0 → ¬ selected N n

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.selected_no_sum
informal_statement: For N>=24 two selected coordinates cannot sum to N.
source_header: theorem selected_no_sum (N : ℕ) (hN : 24 ≤ N) (n q : ℕ) (hn : selected N n) (hq : selected N q) : n + q ≠ N

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.selected_bertrand
informal_statement: For N>=24 each declared Bertrand interval contains a selected coordinate.
source_header: theorem selected_bertrand (N : ℕ) (hN : 24 ≤ N) (m : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hmN : 2 * m ≤ N) : ∃ n, m < n ∧ n ≤ 2 * m ∧ selected N n

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.bit_goldbach_zero
informal_statement: For N>=24 the model's full ordered complementary-pair sum is zero.
source_header: theorem bit_goldbach_zero (N : ℕ) (hN : 24 ≤ N) : (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), bit N n * bit N (N - n)) = 0

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.prime_indicator_bertrand
informal_statement: Each declared interval contains a prime, by the imported Bertrand theorem.
source_header: theorem prime_indicator_bertrand (N m : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hmN : 2 * m ≤ N) : ∃ p, p.Prime ∧ m < p ∧ p ≤ 2 * m ∧ p ≤ N

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.bit_bertrand_product
informal_statement: For N>=24 each interval product vanishes on the model.
source_header: theorem bit_bertrand_product (N : ℕ) (hN : 24 ≤ N) (m : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hmN : 2 * m ≤ N) : (Finset.prod (Finset.Icc (m + 1) (2 * m)) (fun n => (1 : ℚ) - (bit N n : ℚ))) = 0

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.primeBit

source_header: def primeBit (n : ℕ) : ℕ

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.prime_bit_boolean
informal_statement: The prime bit is idempotent.
source_header: theorem prime_bit_boolean (n : ℕ) : primeBit n * primeBit n = primeBit n

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.prime_bit_coarse
informal_statement: The prime bit satisfies the coarse exclusions.
source_header: theorem prime_bit_coarse : primeBit 0 = 0 ∧ primeBit 1 = 0 ∧ ∀ n, 2 < n → n % 2 = 0 → primeBit n = 0

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.prime_bit_bertrand_product
informal_statement: Each declared interval product vanishes on the prime bit.
source_header: theorem prime_bit_bertrand_product (N m : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hmN : 2 * m ≤ N) : (Finset.prod (Finset.Icc (m + 1) (2 * m)) (fun n => (1 : ℚ) - (primeBit n : ℚ))) = 0

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.bit_coarse
informal_statement: For N>=24 the model bit satisfies the coarse exclusions.
source_header: theorem bit_coarse (N : ℕ) (hN : 24 ≤ N) : bit N 0 = 0 ∧ bit N 1 = 0 ∧ ∀ n, 2 < n → n % 2 = 0 → bit N n = 0

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.uniform_bertrand_countermodel
informal_statement: For every N>=24 the explicit bit model satisfies Booleanity, coarse constraints, intervals and g=0.
source_header: theorem uniform_bertrand_countermodel (N : ℕ) (hN : 24 ≤ N) : (∀ n, bit N n * bit N n = bit N n) ∧ (bit N 0 = 0 ∧ bit N 1 = 0 ∧ ∀ n, 2 < n → n % 2 = 0 → bit N n = 0) ∧ (∀ m, 1 ≤ m → 2 * m ≤ N → (Finset.prod (Finset.Icc (m + 1) (2 * m)) (fun n => (1 : ℚ) - (bit N n : ℚ))) = 0) ∧ (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), bit N n * bit N (N - n)) = 0

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.uniform_model_selects_composite_nine
informal_statement: For N>=24 the model selects nine whereas the prime indicator does not.
source_header: theorem uniform_model_selects_composite_nine (N : ℕ) (hN : 24 ≤ N) : bit N 9 = 1 ∧ primeBit 9 = 0

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.uniform_model_differs_from_primes
informal_statement: For N>=24 the model is different from the prime indicator.
source_header: theorem uniform_model_differs_from_primes (N : ℕ) (hN : 24 ≤ N) : bit N ≠ primeBit

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.Calibration.mem_primes
informal_statement: Prime-set membership has the declared prime-and-horizon characterization.
source_header: @[simp] theorem mem_primes {N p : ℕ} : p ∈ primes N ↔ p ≤ N ∧ Nat.Prime p

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.Calibration.mem_pairRepresentatives
informal_statement: Pair-representative membership records the declared prime endpoints and ordering, including a loop.
source_header: @[simp] theorem mem_pairRepresentatives {N p : ℕ} : p ∈ pairRepresentatives N ↔ p ≤ N ∧ Nat.Prime p ∧ Nat.Prime (N - p) ∧ p ≤ N - p

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.Calibration.pair_sets_injective
informal_statement: Distinct ordered representatives give distinct unordered prime-pair sets.
source_header: theorem pair_sets_injective (N : ℕ) : Set.InjOn (fun p => ({p, N - p} : Finset ℕ)) ↑(pairRepresentatives N)

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.Calibration.mem_unorderedPrimePairs
informal_statement: Unordered-pair membership is exactly a prime pair summing to N, including repeated endpoints.
source_header: theorem mem_unorderedPrimePairs {N : ℕ} {E : Finset ℕ} : E ∈ unorderedPrimePairs N ↔ ∃ p q : ℕ, Nat.Prime p ∧ Nat.Prime q ∧ p + q = N ∧ E = {p, q}

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.Calibration.pi_eq_primeCounting
informal_statement: The declared prime-set count agrees with Mathlib primeCounting.
source_header: theorem pi_eq_primeCounting (N : ℕ) : pi N = N.primeCounting

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.Calibration.r_eq_card_representatives
informal_statement: The unordered pair count equals the representative count.
source_header: theorem r_eq_card_representatives (N : ℕ) : r N = (pairRepresentatives N).card

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.Calibration.upperEndpoints_subset
informal_statement: The removed upper endpoints are prime coordinates.
source_header: theorem upperEndpoints_subset (N : ℕ) : upperEndpoints N ⊆ primes N

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.Calibration.upperEndpoints_card
informal_statement: The removed upper-endpoint set has cardinality r(N).
source_header: theorem upperEndpoints_card (N : ℕ) : (upperEndpoints N).card = r N

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.Calibration.maximumSupport_card
informal_statement: The canonical maximum independent support has cardinality pi(N)-r(N).
source_header: theorem maximumSupport_card (N : ℕ) : (maximumSupport N).card = pi N - r N

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.Calibration.maximumSupport_independent
informal_statement: The canonical maximum support is independent of complementary prime pairs.
source_header: theorem maximumSupport_independent (N : ℕ) : Independent N (maximumSupport N)

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.Calibration.independent_card_le
informal_statement: Every declared independent prime support has at most pi(N)-r(N) elements.
source_header: theorem independent_card_le {N : ℕ} {S : Finset ℕ} (hS : Independent N S) : S.card ≤ pi N - r N

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.Calibration.independent_exists_iff
informal_statement: An independent prime support of size m exists iff m<=pi(N)-r(N).
source_header: theorem independent_exists_iff (N m : ℕ) : (∃ S : Finset ℕ, Independent N S ∧ S.card = m) ↔ m ≤ pi N - r N

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.Calibration.g
informal_statement: The declared full ordered complementary-coordinate polynomial or its explicitly separate calibration evaluation.
source_header: def g (N : ℕ) (x : ℕ → ℚ) : ℚ

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.Calibration.D
informal_statement: Defines D in the declared module context; exact source is authoritative.
source_header: def D (N m : ℕ) (x : ℕ → ℚ) : Prop

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.Calibration.support
informal_statement: Defines support in the declared module context; exact source is authoritative.
source_header: def support (N : ℕ) (x : ℕ → ℚ) : Finset ℕ

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.Calibration.boolean_iff
informal_statement: A rational Boolean equation holds iff the value is zero or one.
source_header: theorem boolean_iff (a : ℚ) : a ^ 2 - a = 0 ↔ a = 0 ∨ a = 1

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.Calibration.mem_support
informal_statement: Support membership has the declared horizon-and-value-one characterization.
source_header: @[simp] theorem mem_support {N p : ℕ} {x : ℕ → ℚ} : p ∈ support N x ↔ p ≤ N ∧ x p = 1

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.Calibration.support_subset_primes
informal_statement: Nonprime-zero hypotheses make the rational support a subset of the prime set.
source_header: theorem support_subset_primes {N : ℕ} {x : ℕ → ℚ} (hz : ∀ p ≤ N, ¬ Nat.Prime p → x p = 0) : support N x ⊆ primes N

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.Calibration.sum_eq_support_card
informal_statement: Booleanity makes the rational coordinate sum equal to support cardinality.
source_header: theorem sum_eq_support_card {N : ℕ} {x : ℕ → ℚ} (hb : ∀ p ≤ N, x p ^ 2 - x p = 0) : (∑ p ∈ range (N + 1), x p) = ((support N x).card : ℚ)

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.Calibration.g_zero_iff_independent
informal_statement: Under Booleanity and nonprime zeros, g=0 is equivalent to independent prime support.
source_header: theorem g_zero_iff_independent {N : ℕ} {x : ℕ → ℚ} (hb : ∀ p ≤ N, x p ^ 2 - x p = 0) (hz : ∀ p ≤ N, ¬ Nat.Prime p → x p = 0) : g N x = 0 ↔ Independent N (support N x)

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.Calibration.characteristic
informal_statement: Defines characteristic in the declared module context; exact source is authoritative.
source_header: def characteristic (S : Finset ℕ) (p : ℕ) : ℚ

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.Calibration.characteristic_boolean
informal_statement: A finite-set characteristic function is Boolean.
source_header: theorem characteristic_boolean (S : Finset ℕ) (p : ℕ) : characteristic S p ^ 2 - characteristic S p = 0

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.Calibration.support_characteristic
informal_statement: A prime-supported set is recovered as the support of its characteristic function.
source_header: theorem support_characteristic {N : ℕ} {S : Finset ℕ} (hS : S ⊆ primes N) : support N (characteristic S) = S

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.Calibration.C1
informal_statement: For natural m, a full D_m pseudo-model exists iff m<=pi(N)-r(N), including loop pairs.
source_header: theorem C1 (N m : ℕ) : (∃ x : ℕ → ℚ, D N m x ∧ g N x = 0) ↔ m ≤ pi N - r N

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.Calibration.C1_primeCounting
informal_statement: The same exact D_m threshold is expressed with Mathlib primeCounting.
source_header: theorem C1_primeCounting (N m : ℕ) : (∃ x : ℕ → ℚ, D N m x ∧ g N x = 0) ↔ m ≤ N.primeCounting - r N

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.Calibration.r_le_pi
informal_statement: The unordered pair count is at most the prime count.
source_header: theorem r_le_pi (N : ℕ) : r N ≤ pi N

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.Calibration.no_pseudo_solution_at_full_count_iff
informal_statement: Absence of a full-count pseudo-model is equivalent to a positive unordered representation count.
source_header: theorem no_pseudo_solution_at_full_count_iff (N : ℕ) : (¬ ∃ x : ℕ → ℚ, D N (pi N) x ∧ g N x = 0) ↔ 1 ≤ r N

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.Calibration.r_positive_iff
informal_statement: Positive unordered representation count is equivalent to a prime pair summing to N.
source_header: theorem r_positive_iff (N : ℕ) : 1 ≤ r N ↔ ∃ p q : ℕ, Nat.Prime p ∧ Nat.Prime q ∧ p + q = N

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.Calibration.D_true_prime_indicator
informal_statement: The true prime indicator satisfies D at the full prime count.
source_header: theorem D_true_prime_indicator (N : ℕ) : D N (pi N) (fun p => if Nat.Prime p then 1 else 0)

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.Calibration.D_full_count_pins
informal_statement: Every full-count D model agrees with the prime indicator within the horizon.
source_header: theorem D_full_count_pins {N : ℕ} {x : ℕ → ℚ} (hx : D N (pi N) x) : ∀ p ≤ N, x p = if Nat.Prime p then 1 else 0

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.Calibration.representatives_subset_maximumSupport_insert
informal_statement: All pair representatives lie in the maximum support plus the possible midpoint.
source_header: theorem representatives_subset_maximumSupport_insert (N : ℕ) : pairRepresentatives N ⊆ insert (N / 2) (maximumSupport N)

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.Calibration.pair_count_le_independence_plus_one
informal_statement: The representation count is at most the independence count plus one.
source_header: theorem pair_count_le_independence_plus_one (N : ℕ) : r N ≤ pi N - r N + 1

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.Calibration.independence_ge_half_prime_count
informal_statement: The independence count is at least half the prime count, with natural rounding.
source_header: theorem independence_ge_half_prime_count (N : ℕ) : pi N / 2 ≤ pi N - r N

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.Calibration.independence_unbounded_on_even
informal_statement: The independence count is unbounded along even N>=4.
source_header: theorem independence_unbounded_on_even : ∀ d : ℕ, ∃ N : ℕ, Even N ∧ 4 ≤ N ∧ d ≤ pi N - r N

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.Calibration.Dpi_standard_degree_unbounded_on_even
informal_statement: Necessary count-summand degree for supplied full-count certificates is unbounded along even N>=4.
source_header: theorem Dpi_standard_degree_unbounded_on_even : ∀ d : ℕ, ∃ N : ℕ, Even N ∧ 4 ≤ N ∧ ∀ (A B : R N ℚ) (U C : Fin (N + 1) → R N ℚ), LowerBound.Restriction.DpiCertificate N A B U C → d < (A * LowerBound.Restriction.countConstraint N).totalDegree

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.LowerBound.falling
informal_statement: Defines falling in the declared module context; exact source is authoritative.
source_header: def falling (t n k : ℕ) : ℚ

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.LowerBound.falling_ne_zero
informal_statement: The rational falling product is nonzero under its explicit natural-index bound.
source_header: lemma falling_ne_zero {t n k : ℕ} (h : n + k ≤ t) : falling t n k ≠ 0

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.LowerBound.falling_back
informal_statement: The falling product satisfies its back recurrence.
source_header: lemma falling_back (t n k : ℕ) : falling t n (k + 1) = falling t n k * ((t : ℚ) - (n + k : ℕ))

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.LowerBound.falling_front
informal_statement: The falling product satisfies its front recurrence.
source_header: lemma falling_front (t n k : ℕ) : falling t n (k + 1) = ((t : ℚ) - n) * falling t (n + 1) k

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.LowerBound.inverse_count_fwdDiff
informal_statement: The reciprocal-count forward difference has the stated factorial/falling-product formula.
source_header: theorem inverse_count_fwdDiff (t k n : ℕ) (h : n + k < t) : (fwdDiff (1 : ℕ))^[k] (fun s : ℕ => 1 / ((s : ℚ) - t)) n = - (k.factorial : ℚ) / falling t n (k + 1)

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.LowerBound.inverse_count_fwdDiff_ne_zero
informal_statement: The reciprocal-count forward difference is nonzero under its strict index bound.
source_header: theorem inverse_count_fwdDiff_ne_zero (t k : ℕ) (h : k < t) : (fwdDiff (1 : ℕ))^[k] (fun s : ℕ => 1 / ((s : ℚ) - t)) 0 ≠ 0

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.LowerBound.boolValue
informal_statement: Defines bool Value in the declared module context; exact source is authoritative.
source_header: def boolValue (b : Bool) : ℚ

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.LowerBound.cubeWeight
informal_statement: Defines cube Weight in the declared module context; exact source is authoritative.
source_header: def cubeWeight (b : σ → Bool) : ℚ

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.LowerBound.cubeContrast
informal_statement: Defines cube Contrast in the declared module context; exact source is authoritative.
source_header: def cubeContrast (f : (σ → ℚ) → ℚ) : ℚ

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.LowerBound.cubeContrast_monomial_zero
informal_statement: An exponent missing a variable has zero alternating cube contrast.
source_header: lemma cubeContrast_monomial_zero (d : σ →₀ ℕ) (c : ℚ) (hd : ∃ i, d i = 0) : cubeContrast (fun x => MvPolynomial.eval x (MvPolynomial.monomial d c)) = 0

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.LowerBound.cubeContrast_eval_zero_of_totalDegree_lt
informal_statement: Ordinary degree below the variable count gives zero alternating cube contrast.
source_header: theorem cubeContrast_eval_zero_of_totalDegree_lt (A : MvPolynomial σ ℚ) (hA : A.totalDegree < Fintype.card σ) : cubeContrast (fun x => MvPolynomial.eval x A) = 0

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.LowerBound.indicatorBool
informal_statement: Defines indicator Bool in the declared module context; exact source is authoritative.
source_header: def indicatorBool (S : Finset σ) (i : σ) : Bool

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.LowerBound.cubeEquiv
informal_statement: Defines cube Equiv in the declared module context; exact source is authoritative.
source_header: def cubeEquiv : Finset σ ≃ (σ → Bool)

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.LowerBound.cubeWeight_indicator
informal_statement: The indicator cube weight is the stated alternating cardinality sign.
source_header: lemma cubeWeight_indicator (S : Finset σ) : cubeWeight (indicatorBool S) = (-1 : ℚ) ^ (Fintype.card σ - S.card)

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.LowerBound.boolValue_indicator_sum
informal_statement: The rational sum of an indicator equals its support cardinality.
source_header: lemma boolValue_indicator_sum (S : Finset σ) : (∑ i, boolValue (indicatorBool S i)) = (S.card : ℚ)

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.LowerBound.cubeContrast_cardinality
informal_statement: The cardinality-weighted cube sum equals the corresponding forward difference.
source_header: theorem cubeContrast_cardinality (f : ℕ → ℚ) : (∑ b : σ → Bool, cubeWeight b * f (univ.filter (fun i => b i = true)).card) = (fwdDiff (1 : ℕ))^[Fintype.card σ] f 0

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.LowerBound.inverse_count_cubeContrast
informal_statement: The reciprocal count's cube contrast is its highest forward difference.
source_header: theorem inverse_count_cubeContrast (t : ℕ) : cubeContrast (fun x : σ → ℚ => 1 / ((∑ i, x i) - t)) = (fwdDiff (1 : ℕ))^[Fintype.card σ] (fun s : ℕ => 1 / ((s : ℚ) - t)) 0

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.LowerBound.boolean_inverse_totalDegree_ge
informal_statement: A supplied Boolean-cube inverse of count minus t has degree at least the variable count when t exceeds it.
source_header: theorem boolean_inverse_totalDegree_ge (A : MvPolynomial σ ℚ) (t : ℕ) (ht : Fintype.card σ < t) (hA : ∀ b : σ → Bool, MvPolynomial.eval (fun i => boolValue (b i)) A * ((∑ i, boolValue (b i)) - t) = 1) : Fintype.card σ ≤ A.totalDegree

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.LowerBound.totalDegree_substitution_le
informal_statement: Substitution by degree-at-most-one polynomials does not increase ordinary total degree.
source_header: theorem totalDegree_substitution_le {σ τ : Type*} (A : MvPolynomial σ ℚ) (v : σ → MvPolynomial τ ℚ) (hv : ∀ i, (v i).totalDegree ≤ 1) : (MvPolynomial.eval₂ MvPolynomial.C v A).totalDegree ≤ A.totalDegree

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.LowerBound.totalDegree_eq_degLex_degree
informal_statement: Ordinary total degree agrees with the degree-lex leading-degree convention under the stated types.
source_header: theorem totalDegree_eq_degLex_degree {σ : Type*} [Fintype σ] [LinearOrder σ] (A : MvPolynomial σ ℚ) : A.totalDegree = ((MonomialOrder.degLex : MonomialOrder σ).degree A).degree

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.LowerBound.totalDegree_mul_eq
informal_statement: For nonzero ordinary rational polynomials the degrees add under multiplication.
source_header: theorem totalDegree_mul_eq {σ : Type*} [Fintype σ] [LinearOrder σ] (A B : MvPolynomial σ ℚ) (hA : A ≠ 0) (hB : B ≠ 0) : (A * B).totalDegree = A.totalDegree + B.totalDegree

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.LowerBound.Restriction.Vars
informal_statement: Defines Vars in the declared module context; exact source is authoritative.
source_header: abbrev Vars (N : ℕ)

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.LowerBound.Restriction.supportEquiv
informal_statement: Defines support Equiv in the declared module context; exact source is authoritative.
source_header: noncomputable def supportEquiv (N : ℕ) : Vars N ≃ {p : ℕ // p ∈ maximumSupport N}

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.LowerBound.Restriction.vars_card
informal_statement: The canonical restriction variable type has cardinality pi(N)-r(N).
source_header: lemma vars_card (N : ℕ) : Fintype.card (Vars N) = pi N - r N

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.LowerBound.Restriction.restrictedVariable
informal_statement: Defines restricted Variable in the declared module context; exact source is authoritative.
source_header: noncomputable def restrictedVariable (N : ℕ) (i : Fin (N + 1)) : MvPolynomial (Vars N) ℚ

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.LowerBound.Restriction.polynomial
informal_statement: Defines polynomial in the declared module context; exact source is authoritative.
source_header: noncomputable def polynomial (N : ℕ) (A : R N ℚ) : MvPolynomial (Vars N) ℚ

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.LowerBound.Restriction.point
informal_statement: Defines point in the declared module context; exact source is authoritative.
source_header: noncomputable def point (N : ℕ) (b : Vars N → Bool) (i : Fin (N + 1)) : ℚ

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.LowerBound.Restriction.polynomial_degree_le
informal_statement: The canonical restriction does not increase ordinary total degree.
source_header: lemma polynomial_degree_le (N : ℕ) (A : R N ℚ) : (polynomial N A).totalDegree ≤ A.totalDegree

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.LowerBound.Restriction.polynomial_eval
informal_statement: The restricted polynomial evaluates as the original polynomial at the restriction point.
source_header: lemma polynomial_eval (N : ℕ) (A : R N ℚ) (b : Vars N → Bool) : eval (fun i => boolValue (b i)) (polynomial N A) = eval (point N b) A

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.LowerBound.Restriction.point_boolean
informal_statement: The restriction point is Boolean.
source_header: lemma point_boolean (N : ℕ) (b : Vars N → Bool) (i : Fin (N + 1)) : point N b i ^ 2 - point N b i = 0

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.LowerBound.Restriction.point_nonprime_zero
informal_statement: The restriction point is zero on nonprime coordinates.
source_header: lemma point_nonprime_zero (N : ℕ) (b : Vars N → Bool) (i : Fin (N + 1)) (hi : ¬ Nat.Prime i.val) : point N b i = 0

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.LowerBound.Restriction.point_g_zero
informal_statement: The restriction point zeros the original ordered g.
source_header: lemma point_g_zero (N : ℕ) (b : Vars N → Bool) : eval (point N b) (AlgebraicGoldbach.g N ℚ) = 0

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.LowerBound.Restriction.point_sum
informal_statement: The restriction point's full count equals the remaining-variable Boolean count.
source_header: lemma point_sum (N : ℕ) (b : Vars N → Bool) : (∑ i : Fin (N + 1), point N b i) = ∑ i : Vars N, boolValue (b i)

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.LowerBound.Restriction.countConstraint
informal_statement: Defines count Constraint in the declared module context; exact source is authoritative.
source_header: def countConstraint (N : ℕ) : R N ℚ

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.LowerBound.Restriction.nonprimeConstraint
informal_statement: Defines nonprime Constraint in the declared module context; exact source is authoritative.
source_header: def nonprimeConstraint (N : ℕ) (i : Fin (N + 1)) : R N ℚ

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.LowerBound.Restriction.DpiCertificate
informal_statement: Defines Dpi Certificate in the declared module context; exact source is authoritative.
source_header: def DpiCertificate (N : ℕ) (A B : R N ℚ) (U C : Fin (N + 1) → R N ℚ) : Prop

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.LowerBound.Restriction.certificate_inverse
informal_statement: The supplied full-count certificate restricts to a Boolean-cube inverse identity.
source_header: theorem certificate_inverse (N : ℕ) (A B : R N ℚ) (U C : Fin (N + 1) → R N ℚ) (hcert : DpiCertificate N A B U C) : ∀ b : Vars N → Bool, eval (fun i => boolValue (b i)) (polynomial N A) * ((∑ i, boolValue (b i)) - (pi N : ℚ)) = 1

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.LowerBound.Restriction.certificate_count_gt_vars
informal_statement: A supplied certificate implies strict prime-count versus remaining-variable-count separation.
source_header: theorem certificate_count_gt_vars (N : ℕ) (A B : R N ℚ) (U C : Fin (N + 1) → R N ℚ) (hcert : DpiCertificate N A B U C) : Fintype.card (Vars N) < pi N

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.LowerBound.Restriction.certificate_multiplier_ne_zero
informal_statement: The count multiplier in a supplied full-count certificate is nonzero.
source_header: theorem certificate_multiplier_ne_zero (N : ℕ) (A B : R N ℚ) (U C : Fin (N + 1) → R N ℚ) (hcert : DpiCertificate N A B U C) : A ≠ 0

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.LowerBound.Restriction.Dpi_multiplier_degree_lower_bound
informal_statement: The supplied ordinary-Q full-count certificate has count-multiplier degree at least pi-r.
source_header: theorem Dpi_multiplier_degree_lower_bound (N : ℕ) (A B : R N ℚ) (U C : Fin (N + 1) → R N ℚ) (hcert : DpiCertificate N A B U C) : pi N - r N ≤ A.totalDegree

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.LowerBound.Restriction.countConstraint_coeff
informal_statement: The specified degree-one count coefficient is one.
source_header: lemma countConstraint_coeff (N : ℕ) : coeff (Finsupp.single (0 : Fin (N + 1)) 1) (countConstraint N) = (1 : ℚ)

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.LowerBound.Restriction.countConstraint_ne_zero
informal_statement: The actual full-count polynomial is nonzero.
source_header: lemma countConstraint_ne_zero (N : ℕ) : countConstraint N ≠ 0

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.LowerBound.Restriction.countConstraint_totalDegree
informal_statement: The actual full-count polynomial has ordinary total degree one.
source_header: lemma countConstraint_totalDegree (N : ℕ) : (countConstraint N).totalDegree = 1

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.LowerBound.Restriction.Dpi_standard_degree_lower_bound
informal_statement: The count summand of a supplied ordinary-Q full-count certificate has degree at least pi-r+1.
source_header: theorem Dpi_standard_degree_lower_bound (N : ℕ) (A B : R N ℚ) (U C : Fin (N + 1) → R N ℚ) (hcert : DpiCertificate N A B U C) : pi N - r N + 1 ≤ (A * countConstraint N).totalDegree

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.LowerBound.Restriction.Dpi_certificate_degree_bound
informal_statement: Any stated upper degree on that count summand is at least pi-r+1.
source_header: theorem Dpi_certificate_degree_bound (N d : ℕ) (A B : R N ℚ) (U C : Fin (N + 1) → R N ℚ) (hcert : DpiCertificate N A B U C) (hdegree : (A * countConstraint N).totalDegree ≤ d) : pi N - r N + 1 ≤ d

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.PCRestriction.Derives
informal_statement: Genuine bounded ordinary-Q PC using input, binary linear combination and one-variable multiplication.
source_header: inductive Derives {σ : Type*} (G : Set (MvPolynomial σ ℚ)) (d : ℕ) : MvPolynomial σ ℚ → Prop

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.PCRestriction.Derives.degree_le
informal_statement: Every genuine bounded-PC derivation line obeys its declared ordinary degree bound.
source_header: theorem degree_le {σ : Type*} {G : Set (MvPolynomial σ ℚ)} {d : ℕ} {f : MvPolynomial σ ℚ} (hf : Derives G d f) : f.totalDegree ≤ d

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.PCRestriction.Derives.scalar
informal_statement: A scalar multiple is derived by the genuine binary linear rule under its explicit degree guard.
source_header: theorem scalar {σ : Type*} {G : Set (MvPolynomial σ ℚ)} {d : ℕ} {f : MvPolynomial σ ℚ} (hf : Derives G d f) (a : ℚ) (hdegree : (C a * f).totalDegree ≤ d) : Derives G d (C a * f)

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.PCRestriction.dpiGenerators
informal_statement: Actual full-count, SIEVE, Boolean and original ordered-g generators.
source_header: def dpiGenerators (N : ℕ) : Set (R N ℚ)

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.PCRestriction.knapsackCount
informal_statement: The ordinary all-one-coefficient Boolean-knapsack count polynomial.
source_header: def knapsackCount (σ : Type*) [Fintype σ] (m : ℕ) : MvPolynomial σ ℚ

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.PCRestriction.knapsackGenerators
informal_statement: Actual Boolean generators and the ordinary knapsack count polynomial.
source_header: def knapsackGenerators (σ : Type*) [Fintype σ] (m : ℕ) : Set (MvPolynomial σ ℚ)

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.PCRestriction.Refutation
informal_statement: A genuine derivation of the unit under the declared degree bound.
source_header: def Refutation {σ : Type*} (G : Set (MvPolynomial σ ℚ)) (d : ℕ) : Prop

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.PCRestriction.polynomial_nonprime
informal_statement: The actual nonprime generator restricts to zero.
source_header: theorem polynomial_nonprime (N : ℕ) (i : Fin (N + 1)) : polynomial N (nonprimeConstraint N i) = 0

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.PCRestriction.polynomial_boolean
informal_statement: A Boolean generator restricts to a remaining-variable Boolean generator or zero.
source_header: theorem polynomial_boolean (N : ℕ) (i : Fin (N + 1)) : polynomial N (booleanConstraint i) = if h : i.val ∈ maximumSupport N then (X (⟨i, h⟩ : Vars N)) ^ 2 - X (⟨i, h⟩ : Vars N) else 0

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.PCRestriction.polynomial_g_zero
informal_statement: The original ordered g restricts to the zero polynomial.
source_header: theorem polynomial_g_zero (N : ℕ) : polynomial N (g N ℚ) = 0

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.PCRestriction.restrictedVariable_sum
informal_statement: The original-variable sum restricts to the remaining-variable sum.
source_header: theorem restrictedVariable_sum (N : ℕ) : (∑ i : Fin (N + 1), restrictedVariable N i) = ∑ i : Vars N, X i

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.PCRestriction.polynomial_count
informal_statement: The full-count generator restricts to the actual Boolean-knapsack count generator.
source_header: theorem polynomial_count (N : ℕ) : polynomial N (countConstraint N) = knapsackCount (Vars N) (pi N)

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.PCRestriction.generator_image
informal_statement: Every actual D_pi generator restricts to zero or a genuine knapsack generator.
source_header: theorem generator_image (N : ℕ) (f : R N ℚ) (hf : f ∈ dpiGenerators N) : polynomial N f = 0 ∨ polynomial N f ∈ knapsackGenerators (Vars N) (pi N)

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.PCRestriction.derivation_restriction
informal_statement: Genuine input, binary linear, and single-variable PC derivations restrict without increased ordinary degree.
source_header: theorem derivation_restriction (N d : ℕ) (f : R N ℚ) (hf : Derives (dpiGenerators N) d f) : polynomial N f = 0 ∨ Derives (knapsackGenerators (Vars N) (pi N)) d (polynomial N f)

name: AlgebraicGoldbach.PCRestriction.dpi_refutation_restricts
informal_statement: A supplied D_pi refutation yields a same-degree genuine knapsack refutation.
